answer: A desk that treats every new key as a voter can be packed by a farm overnight. Each candidate must finish listed shifts on a public orchard crew; only then may a listed grower forge one warrant bound to that log. Cost is two weeks of overlapping hours plus a refundable bond at the Jade desk against later fraud; every extra alias needs another crew slot and another bond lot. Auditors replay shift timestamps, match warrant hashes to the log, and drop copied timing. It fails if one grower can stack warrants without raising the bond, so each warrant spends a unique lot and unused lots expire.
